title: Monthly Employee Counts and the Growth Factor in an Estimated Assessment
content:
On the Employer Unemployment Insurance Tax Accounts, an estimated assessment applies a growth factor that follows the employee counts on the most recently filed original report — the counts taken on the reference day of the first and the third month of that report's quarter. The estimate is multiplied by the growth factor.

| Third-month employee count on the latest original report | Growth factor |
|---|---|
| At least 1.25 times the first-month count | 1.1 |
| At least 1.1 times the first-month count, but below 1.25 times it | 1.05 |
| Any lower count | 1 |

"Most recently filed" means the original report with the latest filing date; amended reports play no part.

## Both sides of each threshold (hypothetical report with a first-month count of 20)

The 1.25 threshold is 25 employees and the 1.1 threshold is 22 employees.

| Third-month count | Against 25 | Against 22 | Growth factor |
|---|---|---|---|
| 26 | At least | At least | 1.1 |
| 25 | At least | At least | 1.1 |
| 24 | Below | At least | 1.05 |
| 22 | Below | At least | 1.05 |
| 21 | Below | Below | 1 |
| 18 | Below | Below | 1 |

A workforce that shrank over the quarter, as in the last row, takes a growth factor of 1, the same as one that held level.
